final: WITH race_country AS (SELECT ds.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ds.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_country GROUP BY country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_avg_wins FROM country_avg), differences AS (SELECT country, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT avg_avg_wins FROM overall_avg) AS diff FROM country_avg) SELECT country, avg_wins, diff, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM differences) AS final_diff FROM differences WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM differences) AND avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM differences) > (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM differences)
